reason: The executed client/non-client subtyping checks inspect four trapped errors through e1.detail() through e4.detail() and assert their detail message strings. error:detail is outside the explicitly supported langlib methods, so this whole case requires an unsupported feature even though class equivalency, client classes, casts, trapping and asynchronous tuple testing use listed constructs.
unsupported_constructs: ballerina/lang.error:detail, invoked as e1.detail(), e2.detail(), e3.detail() and e4.detail() in testSubtypingBetweenNonClientAndClientObject
test_design_notes: main invokes the subtyping checks, so detail extraction is essential to the asserted runtime behavior.
io:println calls are output instrumentation; value:toString is explicitly supported.
